note: State park on the Platte bluffs between Omaha and Lincoln. The RV campground (Bison Lane) is on the park's west side off the main road: three paved rows of 50-55 ft full-hookup sites plus a herringbone of pull-throughs, open lawn, little shade, well inland from the river. Cabins, tepees, lodge restaurant, pool, park lake. NE park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms Bison Lane Campground as the park's only RV camping: full hookups (50 A, water, sewer) on paved 50-55 ft sites, back-ins and pull-throughs; sites 31-49 reservable 180 to 3 days out, the rest first come; $35 in season (quoted, matches the grid). Written. The stored pin is ~960 m east at the park entrance loop. Park office (402) 234-2217.
